title: "STICS Evaluation Dashboard"

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("_common.R") # nolint: undesirable_function_linter.

evaluation_status <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "evaluation_status.csv"))
species_summary <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "species_summary.csv"))
usm_summary <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "usm_summary.csv"))
species_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path("csv", "species_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)

# Only the species of `species_stats.csv` get a page (see
# `get_species_list()` in render_report.R).
species_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "species_stats.csv"))
species_href <- function(species) {
  ifelse(
    species %in% species_stats$species,
    file.path("species", paste0(species, ".html")),
    NA_character_
  )
}
# Straight to the "Failed USMs" section of the species page.
failed_usms_href <- function(species) {
  links <- species_href(species)
  ifelse(is.na(links), NA_character_, paste0(links, "#failed-usms"))
}
```

## Evaluation status

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| eval: !expr '!is.null(evaluation_status)'
icons <- c(
  skip = '<span style="color:#888;">&#8211;</span>',
  pass = '<span style="color:#2ecc71;">&#10004;</span>',
  fail = '<span style="color:#e74c3c;">&#10008;</span>'
)

# `which()` drops NAs, so a missing status or success counts as FALSE.
not_eval <- which(evaluation_status$status == "not evaluated")
state <- rep("fail", nrow(evaluation_status))
state[which(evaluation_status$success)] <- "pass"
state[not_eval] <- "skip"

label <- htmltools::htmlEscape(evaluation_status$evaluation)
label[not_eval] <- sprintf(
  "%s (not evaluated: %s)",
  label[not_eval], htmltools::htmlEscape(evaluation_status$reason[not_eval])
)

cat(paste(icons[state], label, collapse = "&emsp;"), "\n\n")
```

## Species evaluation

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(species_summary)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  categories <- c(
    Critical = "Major degradation",
    Warning = "Minor degradation",
    OK = "No degradation"
  )

  blocks <- vapply(names(categories), function(status) {
    species <- species_summary$species[species_summary$status %in% status]
    sprintf(
      "<p><strong>%s</strong><br>\n%s</p>",
      categories[[status]], tag_list(species, status, href = species_href)
    )
  }, character(1))
  writeLines(c(
    '<div class="summary-block">',
    "<p>The following species show at least one variable with:</p>",
    blocks,
    "</div>\n\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Overview heatmap of the species-level status of every variable
# (variables in rows, as there are many more of them than species; species
# in columns), from `species_rrmse_comparison.csv`. Species are sorted like
# the badges above (most degraded first), variables by the number of
# species where they are critical, then warning.
status_levels <- c("Not tested", "Improved", "Warning", "Critical")
overview <- species_comparison
if (!is.null(overview)) {
  overview <- overview[overview$status %in% status_levels, , drop = FALSE]
}
show_overview <- !is.null(overview) && nrow(overview) > 0

if (show_overview) {
  severity <- function(status, by) {
    tapply(overview$status == status, overview[[by]], sum)
  }
  species <- names(sort(
    severity("Critical", "species") * 1000 + severity("Warning", "species"),
    decreasing = TRUE
  ))
  n_crit <- severity("Critical", "variable")
  n_warn <- severity("Warning", "variable")
  vars <- names(n_crit)[order(-n_crit, -n_warn, names(n_crit))]

  cells <- cbind(
    match(overview$variable, vars), match(overview$species, species)
  )
  z <- matrix(NA_real_, length(vars), length(species))
  z[cells] <- match(overview$status, status_levels)
  hover <- matrix("Not evaluated", length(vars), length(species))
  hover[cells] <- sprintf(
    "Species: %s<br>Variable: %s<br>Status: %s<br>rRMSE ratio: %+.2f%%<br>rRMSE: %.3g (ref %.3g)<br>n_obs: %d", # nolint: line_length_linter
    overview$species, overview$variable, overview$status,
    overview$rrmse_ratio, overview$rrmse_eval, overview$rrmse_ref,
    overview$n_obs
  )
  # Clicking a cell opens the species page, at the variable's scatter plot
  # for the degraded ones (the only ones with a scatter plot, see the
  # `scatter-<variable>` anchors of species.qmd).
  links <- matrix("", length(vars), length(species))
  degraded <- overview$status %in% c("Critical", "Warning")
  links[cells] <- ifelse(
    is.na(species_href(overview$species)), "",
    paste0(
      species_href(overview$species),
      ifelse(
        degraded,
        paste0(
          "#", scatter_id(overview$variable)
        ),
        ""
      )
    )
  )

  # One flat color band per status, matching the badges.
  status_colors <- c("#d5d8dc", "#82e0aa", "#f5b041", "#c0392b")
  bands <- seq(0, 1, length.out = length(status_levels) + 1)
  colorscale <- do.call(c, lapply(seq_along(status_colors), function(i) {
    list(
      list(bands[i], status_colors[i]), list(bands[i + 1], status_colors[i])
    )
  }))

  overview_heatmap <- plotly::plot_ly(
    x = species, y = vars, z = z,
    type = "heatmap", text = hover, hoverinfo = "text",
    zmin = 0.5, zmax = length(status_levels) + 0.5,
    colorscale = colorscale,
    colorbar = list(
      tickvals = seq_along(status_levels), ticktext = status_levels,
      len = 1, thickness = 15
    ),
    xgap = 1, ygap = 1,
    # No fixed width: the plot fills the content column, so its color bar
    # isn't cut off next to the sidebar and table of contents.
    height = 120 + 18 * length(vars)
  ) |>
    plotly::layout(
      xaxis = list(side = "top", type = "category"),
      yaxis = list(autorange = "reversed", type = "category"),
      plot_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
      margin = list(t = 60)
    ) |>
    plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE) |>
    # `links` is passed to the JS callback as its third argument (plotly
    # drops a matrix `customdata` on heatmaps), indexed by the clicked
    # cell's [row, column].
    htmlwidgets::onRender(
      "function(el, x, links) {
        el.classList.add('overview-heatmap');
        el.on('plotly_click', function(data) {
          var cell = data.points[0].pointIndex;
          var url = links[cell[0]][cell[1]];
          if (url) window.location.href = url;
        });
      }",
      data = links
    )

  cat("### Overview by variable\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Printed from a regular (non-`asis`) chunk so that knitr registers the
# widget's JS dependencies (plotly.js) in the page. The plot keeps one row
# per variable at a readable height, inside a box of fixed height that
# scrolls when there are many variables (see `.overview-scroll`).
if (show_overview) {
  htmltools::div(class = "overview-scroll", overview_heatmap)
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (show_overview) {
  cat(paste0(
    "::: {.callout-note}\n",
    "Species-level status of each variable (rRMSE ratio vs. the reference ",
    "version, over all the USMs of the species). Hover a cell for the ",
    "details, click it to open the species page (at the variable's ",
    "scatter plot when it is degraded). White cells are variables not ",
    "evaluated for that species.\n",
    ":::\n\n"
  ))
}
```

## USM evaluation

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(usm_summary)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo USM evaluation data.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  cat('<div class="summary-block">\n')
  cat("<p>The following species have at least one failed USM:</p>\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Failed</strong><br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(
      usm_summary$species[usm_summary$failed_usms > 0], "Failed",
      href = failed_usms_href
    )
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>Passed</strong> (all USMs ok)<br>\n%s</p>\n",
    tag_list(
      usm_summary$species[usm_summary$failed_usms == 0], "Passed",
      href = species_href
    )
  ))
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
```
